ns2:course.label: Multifunctional Landscapes
ns2:course.description: Introduction to research and technology in sustainable and multifunctional landscapes, within the context of plant science. Topics covered include: site inventory/analysis, plant biodiversity, stormwater management, green roofs, sustainable construction materials, and urban agriculture. This is a project-based course; students will develop sustainable solutions to landscape problems using multimedia applications, graphic design, written text, and video presentation.
